title: Colony dilemmas
summary: Small choices that come out of colony life, each leaving something behind.
text:
Once the colony has people, it starts to have problems only you can settle. A **colony dilemma** is a story card about what the colony is going through right now: a brownout, lean months, a quarrel, who wakes from the cryo bank next, someone hurt. Many are about a colonist by name.

There's rarely a right answer. Each choice moves something: someone's mood, the colony's trust in you, the food store, a policy, a family line, a neighbour's regard. Some lead to a follow-up later on.

Dilemmas don't come all at once: there's a gap after each one, and some can come again if the same trouble returns.
